title: Tech Note: 4D Mobile Generate PDF From HTML

historical_commentary.text: 4D Mobile was built entirely on Wakanda Enterprise (a separate JavaScript/Node.js-based server product), and both 4D Mobile and Wakanda have since been fully discontinued by 4D, making this note's core technology obsolete and non-reproducible with current 4D releases. The generic idea of generating PDFs from HTML server-side via a print/REST service is still a valid pattern, but must now be achieved with entirely different tools (e.g., headless browser PDF services, or 4D's own newer print/report facilities) rather than Wakanda.
related_updates: 4D Mobile discontinued; superseded by ORDA/REST-based responsive web apps and later Qodly
Wakanda Enterprise discontinued as a product entirely
PDF-from-HTML generation now typically done via headless browser tooling or other services, not Wakanda's print service
